title: The app is not free
body: I filled out the extensive questionnaire and goals only to find out that the app is subscription based and is not free at all. I wouldn’t have minded so much if the questionnaire didn’t take so long to complete. If you’re looking for a free app to help you lose some weight you should definitely look elsewhere.
